ctx.x: MR. CALDWELL: And Johnny (unintelligible) taken it and he'd play it for about two months, say, you come on and get your saxophone. I said, all right, but, I said, I thought you were going to play the thing. It still wasn't played. But (by) that time I was ready to there moderator could leave Chicago and go to New York. So I'd taken my old horn -- it was a good horn -- and left it was getting with Mamie home. I (back) (unintelligible) coming to New York. Mamie But (unintelligible) interested in the clarinet.

Then Hawk came through before I left with Mamie, slap tonguing and I got stuck playing with the tenor. Hawk was (unin- telligible). He was crazy about my clarinet style. I said-- he said to me, said, hey, say, why don't you come on and join us? I said, well, Hawk --
